text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Whatever is the matter, Dober? Sighing 
on your own birthday?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry. ...Well, because it's my 
birthday, there are parties at the Mejiro 
estate and all, so I've been meeting a lot 
of people I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Mmm, feeling blue, are we? OK—Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ha! ...Funnyaka~ hannyaka~, fungyaro~, 
hop! ...It's here! The lucky word is "Bon 
Odori"!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
All right! ...Leave it to me, Dober. This 
world's Pearl shall manekitaru your smile!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Round and round and round! Round and round 
and round! Manekitaru-ing! All! Your! 
Smiles!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! In that case, unworthy though I may 
be, I shall join as well!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Round and round and round! Round and round 
and round! Manekitaru-ing! All! Your! 
Smiles!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Heh. Fufufu! Oh, come on, what's 
that!"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That smile, Dober! Smile all the more 
when you're feeling blue! Do that, and 
you'll be a lucky girl!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Especially when you're feeling blue, huh? 
...That's true. After all, good fortune 
comes to those who smile!
